name: external buffer
message: Only self-contained GLB geometry is supported. External buffers are blocked.

name: external texture
message: External or URI textures are unsupported. Export a GLB with embedded resources.

name: unsupported compression
message: Unsupported glTF extension: KHR_draco_mesh_compression. Export static, uncompressed geometry without material extensions.

name: animation
message: Animated, skinned and morph-target models are unsupported. Export a static mesh.

name: cyclic hierarchy
message: Invalid or excessively deep GLB hierarchy.
